Most of the smart lighting in your home is likely small bulbs or socket adapters, but as the market matures, complete lighting product lines that natively connect to Apple Home via the Matter protocol are beginning to emerge. SwitchBot has recently launched the new SwitchBot RGBICWW Ceiling Light, featuring extremely high brightness and native Matter support, allowing it to be installed directly in your home's ceiling light fixture.

The HomeKit Weekly column focuses on smart home accessories, automation tips, and news related to Apple's smart home framework.

Native Matter Support and Apple Home Integration

The most striking selling point of this new ceiling light is its out-of-the-box Matter support, requiring no SwitchBot Hub. As long as your Apple TV 4K or HomePod remains connected, it can join your existing smart home system directly via a 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network.

Hardware Size and Brightness

SwitchBot offers two sizes to meet different needs. The 12-inch model is suitable for hallways and bathrooms, with a brightness of 2000 lumens; the larger 15-inch model is better suited for living rooms and bedrooms, with a maximum brightness of up to 3200 lumens. This ceiling light features built-in stepless dimming from 100% to 0%.

Most smart bulbs typically can only display one colour at a time, but this fixture uses RGBIC technology combined with independent chips to display multiple colours simultaneously on the ceiling, creating dynamic lighting effects. If you prefer traditional lighting, the fixture also has built-in independent warm white and cool white LEDs, with colour temperature adjustable from 2700K to 6500K. SwitchBot RGBICWW Summary

Using a 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi connection means adding an always-on device to your router and occupying an older frequency band. If Thread wireless capability were added, response times within a mesh network would be nearly instant. At a price below US$50, you can get a hardwired, natively Matter-supported fixture — a very cost-effective choice for users looking to permanently upgrade their ceiling lighting.

You can purchase this new SwitchBot RGBICWW on Amazon.
